name: TM
recent: TM 近期公告主要来自 EPF 与 KWAP 的股东权益变动申报，未见重大企业活动。新闻方面，公司就 2027 年财政预算案的数码经济措施表态，并提及以 agentic AI 应对基础设施需求。最新财报显示营收同比增 6.8%，但净利同比减 9.3%。
risks: EPF 与 KWAP 在 10 月至 11 月间有多笔股东权益变动申报。
新闻报导有 17 人因 ECRL 与 Telekom Malaysia 电缆盗窃案被捕。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 2,960.4 million，同比增 6.8%，环比增 0.9%；净利为 MYR 365.5 million，同比减 9.3%，环比增 13.7%；净利率为 12.3%，高于上期的 11.0%。

recent_en: TM's recent announcements are mainly substantial shareholder changes by EPF and KWAP, with no major corporate exercises. In the news, the company commented on Budget 2027's digital economy measures and highlighted agentic AI to address infrastructure demand. The latest results show revenue up 6.8% YoY but net profit down 9.3% YoY.
risks_en: EPF and KWAP filed multiple substantial shareholder change notices between October and November.
News reported 17 arrests over ECRL and Telekom Malaysia cable thefts.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 2,960.4 million, up 6.8% YoY and 0.9% QoQ; net profit was MYR 365.5 million, down 9.3% YoY but up 13.7% QoQ; net margin was 12.3%, higher than 11.0% in the prior period.
